introHtml: Scrub embroidered patches are designed specifically for the healthcare industry, offering durability through repeated washings and a professional look that stands up to the demands of medical environments. Whether you need custom patches for hospital staff uniforms, nursing school programs, or medical conference giveaways, these patches can be sewn or ironed onto scrubs and lab coats. Choose from a variety of shapes and sizes to display your facility logo, department name, or employee credentials with pride.
